content:
mira patel: Proposing we add a sampling control for SLO alerts in the console — reduce noisy low-impact alerts during off-peak. Thinking: server-side sampling + per-tenant override. Thoughts?

thomas reed: Agree in principle. We need clear semantics: sampling for notify fanout vs sampling for metric evaluation are different. Which do you mean?

mira patel: Good call. I mean sampling at notify/fanout layer only — still compute and store the alert, just suppress notifications to paging channels for X%. Keeps telemetry intact. :white_check_mark:

leo wang: That makes sense. If we keep counts of suppressed vs fired, we can still do error-budget math. We should expose suppressed_count and suppressed_rate in telemetry.

ashley cole: UX note — keep controls minimal: global default + tenant override + quick toggle in the SLO alert rule. Avoid giving 10 knobs. Mockup I made:
```json
{
  "sampling": {
    "mode": "notify_sampling",
    "default_rate": 0.05,
    "tenant_overrides": {
      "tenant:acme": 0.2
    }
  }
}
```

thomas reed: API implications: new field on NotifyPolicy object, e.g. `notify_sampling_rate` (float 0-1). Server applies a deterministic hash on request id to make sampling stable per-incident. We should document deterministic behavior.

mira patel: Deterministic sampling is important for retries and dedupe. Also want sampling to be configurable per-route (model/tenant/alert-type). Does that explode complexity?

leo wang: Per-route ok if we store effective_rate in route config and cache it. But we must guard performance — lookups should be O(1). Maybe compute a composite key hash of route id + tenant id for stable decisions.

ashley cole: For console, show a small blurb next to alert rules: "Notify sampling: 5% (overrides: 2)" with an info tooltip linking to docs. Also add an inline preview: "Estimated notifications saved per month: ~120" based on tenant activity.

mira patel: Telemetry: we need metrics to evaluate experiment impact. Proposed: `slo_notify_total`, `slo_notify_sent`, `slo_notify_suppressed`, `slo_notify_latency_bucket` and tags for tenant, route, rule. Agree?

leo wang: Yup. Also add `slo_notify_sampled_by_policy` tag so we can split automated suppression from manual silence windows.

thomas reed: Rollout plan: feature-flagged service-side + console toggle. Start with internal tenants, then 10% canary by tenant id (hash range), then 50%, then all. Need to ensure metrics pipeline can handle extra cardinality.

ashley cole: UX experiment idea: A/B test two defaults — 5% vs 0% for small teams to measure missed criticals. We'll need an experiment flag per-tenant + metrics to measure missed-on-call escalations. :thinking_face:

mira patel: Good. For missed criticals signal, we can correlate suppressed_count with post-incident pages and manual escalations. Also add a short-circuit: if a threshold of incident severity is High, ignore sampling.

thomas reed: Implementation note: implement `notify_sampling_rate` on NotifyPolicy, but also allow `min_urgency` to bypass sampling. So policy model: `{rate: 0.05, min_urgency: "high"}`.

leo wang: Ops: need a histogram of suppression latency so we can detect any delays introduced. Also capture sample decision in the trace/span for each alert request.

ashley cole: Console mockup wireframe ready — will drop into Figma and link to PR. Short UI copy suggestions: "Reduce noisy notifications by sampling a percentage of alerts; sampling does not affect SLO math." Keep it simple.

slo-alert-bot: SYSTEM: current notify policy schema v3 -> new optional fields: `notify_sampling_rate` (float), `notify_sampling_mode` ("deterministic"|"random"), `notify_bypass_min_urgency` ("low"|"medium"|"high"). Example command to preview effective config: `/slo preview-config --tenant acme --route billing --policy default`

mira patel: Action items: 1) thomas: PR for API + deterministic hash logic (owner) 2) leo: add suppressed metrics & tracing (owner) 3) ashley: console toggle + tooltip copy + mockups (owner) 4) ops: run cardinality impact analysis on metrics pipeline (ask infra). I'll follow up with rollout schedule.

thomas reed: I'll start the API PR tomorrow, adding tests for determinism and bypass urgency.

leo wang: I'll stub metrics in prod hypothesis job and add a quick Grafana dashboard: `SLO -> Notifications -> sampling experiment` with suppressed/sent ratios.

ashley cole: I'll drop Figma link and short copy in #design later today.

mira patel: Great, thanks. If no blockers, aim for internal-only release next week behind FF. We'll sync on Monday to finalize canary ranges. :rocket:
